office_does: A Court of Appeals judge decides appeals from superior-court cases; District 1 of Division III is elected by voters in Ferry, Lincoln, Okanogan, Pend Oreille, Spokane and Stevens counties.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Tracy Arlene Staab, who won the seat in 2020, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Court of Appeals judge elected in 2020 and a former Spokane Municipal Court judge; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Won the open seat in 2020 against Marshall Casey [S2][S3]
Spokane Municipal Court judge from 2009; earlier an appellate attorney [S2]
Submitted no statement to the 2026 voters' guide [S1]
